title: Tip: inspect the query before you run it
message: After a search, open Query preview to see the Wikimedia request assembled from your active filters. It is a quick way to spot an over-specific combination.

title: Tip: your search is a shareable recipe
message: Search terms, filters, sort order, location, and even Grid or Map view are encoded in the URL. Copy it to share the recipe—not a frozen result list.

title: Tip: Map and Grid share one search
message: Switching to Map keeps the current query and loaded results. Use Map to discover a nearby point, then return to Grid without rebuilding your search.

title: Tip: Browse is for finding Commons vocabulary
message: When ordinary words are not finding the right files, Browse Categories, Templates, or Depicts subjects and apply a result back into Search.

title: Tip: long-press a card to select files
message: Long-press a media card to enter selection mode, then add files to the persistent download queue as you browse different views.

title: Tip: selecting a file does not download it
message: The download queue stores public file references only. Media bytes are fetched when you explicitly start a verified ZIP job or an individual download.

title: Tip: open viewer sections when you need them
message: Structured data, related media, and global usage load when expanded. You can inspect the core file details first without requesting every optional panel.

title: Tip: start attribution from the viewer
message: The How to use this file panel can produce plain text, HTML, or WikiText attribution from the file metadata. Always compare it with the original Commons page before publishing.

title: Tip: follow an uploader into a portfolio
message: Found one useful file? Open its uploader portfolio to explore that Wikimedia username's other uploads without guessing new search terms.

title: Tip: start pipelines with three nodes
message: Try Text Query → Format Filter → Dataset Manifest. Run a preview before exporting, then grow the graph once the simple workflow makes sense.

title: Tip: pipelines can combine branches
message: Use set operations to union, intersect, or subtract two media branches. This is useful when one search describes the subject and another describes the constraint.

title: Tip: check the request log when something feels odd
message: The receipt icon in the top-right of the landing page shows the Wikimedia requests CommonsLens made and the status each one returned.
